atoms.text: Mamad was a wise man and, because he was wise, he never lied. His honesty was known far and wide across the land, for Mamad would not even lie to a fly.
atoms.sound: ssml: The wise man. <break time='700ms'/> <prosody rate = '90%'>Mamad was a wise man and, because he was wise, he never lied. His honesty was known far and wide across the land, for Mamad would not even lie to a fly.</prosody>

atoms.text:
One day, word of Mamad reached the king’s ears. “A man who never lies? Surely that cannot be,” thought the king. “I would like to prove him wrong, for surely my name should be on the lips of my people and not this man, Mamad! What a ridiculous thing to claim! I will see that he breaks his oath.”

And so Mamad was invited to meet the king.

atoms.text: Mamad stood in front of the king. He had travelled five days and nights without sleep to arrive on time. “Is it true that you never lie?” asked the king. Mamad nodded his head in agreement and answered, “It is true that I will never lie.”

atoms.text: Days later, the king requested Mamad’s presence once more. The king was ready to go hunting and wanted Mamad to meet him near the stables, where the horses were saddled and ready.
